title: Scary Movie 2
synopsis: You're invited to a haunted mansion 'for a college study.' The professor has one arm. The cat is talking. The chandelier is, somehow, judging you.

nodes.text: The mansion. The professor. The one arm that does, technically, work in mysterious ways.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Shake the arm.” The story records the instinct as “Polite” and carries it forward.
There is no taking “Refuse politely” back. Cautious shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Hannibal the butler hands you a drink that is, in fact, alive.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Brave.
“Pour it in a plant” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: Your room contains a bed, a closet, and one ghost who is mostly into critique.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Friend—follows you into whatever comes next.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Survival.

nodes.text: Dinner is roast something. The vegetables are screaming. Hannibal pretends not to notice.

choices.consequence: “Eat it” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Manners.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Style.

nodes.text: The cat, named Mr. Kittles, knows everything. Mr. Kittles will tell you, for treats.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Strategy.
There is no taking “Don't trust the cat” back. Wise shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: A floating sheet. A chandelier that judges. A long hallway that's longer when you walk back.

choices.consequence: “Walk fast” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Style—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Buddy, the wheelchair-bound friend from college, arrives. He has, mysteriously, gained the ability to levitate.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Loyal.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Practical—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The basement has, against all reason, a clown room. Nobody likes the clown room.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.
There is no taking “Enter the clown room” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: Theo, the goth, has an opinion about every painting in the house. Her opinions are, occasionally, prophetic.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Tone.

nodes.text: The chandelier delivers a sermon about your choices. The chandelier is, in fact, correct.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Apologize to the chandelier.” The story records the instinct as “Humor” and carries it forward.
You commit to “Argue with the chandelier.” The story records the instinct as “Style” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Hedge maze. The hedge maze is also alive. It is, however, polite.

choices.consequence: “Be polite back” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Tone.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Survival.

nodes.text: There is a sex ghost. He is, somehow, the most polite character in the movie. He offers tea.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Civil—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Civil.

nodes.text: The library has a single book. The book is full of cookie recipes. The recipes are good.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Bake cookies” back. Joy shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Use.

nodes.text: A footman with a chainsaw. He is, alarmingly, also a member of HR.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Smart.
You commit to “File a complaint.” The story records the instinct as “Style” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Buddy can't get out of bed. The bed has, apparently, gained sentience and is filing a counter-claim.

choices.consequence: “Negotiate with the bed” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Diplomacy.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Pragmatic—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: Theo proposes, with great seriousness, a séance. Everyone agrees. The professor brings extra crackers.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Hold the séance” back. Plot shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

choices.text: Hold the séance but eat the crackers first
choices.consequence: There is no taking “Hold the séance but eat the crackers first” back. Snacks shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.

nodes.text: The spirits arrive. They are mostly there for the crackers. One of them files a noise complaint.

choices.consequence: “Sort out the noise complaint” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Civic.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Plot—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: The professor reveals his one-arm origin story. It involves a wedding, a tractor, and his cousin. Nobody is brave enough to ask follow-up questions.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Ask follow-ups” back. Brave shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Mercy—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: All the ghosts in one room. The chandelier presides. Mr. Kittles moderates. Buddy is, against all odds, the swing vote.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Side with the chandelier” back. Style shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Smart—follows you into whatever comes next.

nodes.text: You walk out of the mansion alive, with cookies and a fairly comprehensive HR file.

choices.consequence: The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Practical.

choices.text: Leave the cookies for the ghosts
choices.consequence: “Leave the cookies for the ghosts” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Civil.

nodes.text: A title card promises, somewhere down the road, another sequel. Mr. Kittles winks at the camera. The chandelier sighs.

choices.consequence: There is no taking “Wink back” back. Style shapes the silence before the next moment arrives.
“Pretend not to notice” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Civil.
Some endings reveal themselves last.

nodes.text: The mansion adopts you. You move in. You become, by year's end, an honorary haunting. It is the best apartment you have ever had.
You write a memoir of the weekend. It outsells your other books combined. You retire on the proceeds. You are interviewed, exactly once, on morning TV.
You take the recipe book. You open a small bakery. Mr. Kittles, in a strange way, becomes the bakery's mascot. The chandelier writes you a glowing online review.
